name: capability-fence
description: Best-effort PreToolUse capability fence. Compares the tool being invoked against the active skill's declared allowed-tools list and emits a stderr advisory on mismatch. Observability only; cannot block. Real per-subagent runtime sandboxing requires harness/SDK changes outside plugin scope.
